description.text: Wood Wharf welcomes Signorelli — an independent, family-run bakery founded in 2015 by husband-and-wife team Rebecca and Alberto. Known for their famous pistachio cream croissant, Italian roast coffee and handmade focaccias toasties, they serve up artisan bakes with a personal touch. Their food is made using only high-quality ingredients sourced from local, like-minded small businesses. Pop in for their popular lunch deal: focaccia sandwich + drink + a free handmade cookie. Planning an event? They cater for up to 300 guests with the same quality and care you’ll find in store. Come see what the fuss is about, in their cosy corner of Wood Wharf.
